name: media
description: Media/ffmpeg toolkit - video, audio, image, gif, and metadata tasks
author: DazzleTools
notes: ffmpeg-style media tooling collected into one kit. Phase 1 ships vid2gif (native, new) and vidresize (ported from comfyui_experiment/output/resize-vid.py). Later phases migrate the Z:/omnitools media scripts (vid-preview-maker, vid2img, img2vid, song-to-vid, whatmp3, exiftool). Provenance of each tool is tracked via a 'provenance:<source>' tag in its .dazzlecmd.json taxonomy. Flat kit by design; can graduate to a nested aggregator later without renaming tools. Registry pointer in kits/media.kit.json controls activation only.
